title: A developer automated their entire job search, submitted over 700 applications, and got hired

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: A developer automated their entire job search, submitted over 700 applications, and got hired. Career Ops is the open- source system they built. It scans career pages across 45 plus tech companies, including Stripe, Anthropic, and OpenAI, finds matching roles, rewrites your CV with 14 skill modes to fit each specific position, and generates ATS optimized PDFs via Playright. Ships with a terminal dashboard to monitor batch processing in real
